offers.title: Anker Prime Power Bank (26K, 300W)
offers.summary: 26,250 mAh (99.75 Wh) power bank, model A110A. Two USB-C ports up to 140 W each and one USB-A port up to 22.5 W, 300 W combined. Recharges at up to 250 W using both USB-C ports. Built-in display and app control.

price.conditions: Anker Canada list price read on 2026-10-12; power bank only, without charging base

claims.statement: 300 W max total output; 140 W per USB-C port
Rated 99.75 Wh, under the common 100 Wh carry-on limit

suitable_for: Charging a laptop that accepts 140 W USB-C on the go
Charging a laptop and a phone at the same time
Air travellers who want high capacity while staying under 100 Wh
not_suitable_for: Anyone who wants a pocketable power bank: it weighs 600 g
Checked baggage: lithium power banks must go in carry-on luggage
Fast charging over USB-A: that port is limited to 22.5 W
